title: All the Light We Cannot See
author: Anthony Doerr
summary: A blind French girl and a gifted German boy, drawn into the army, live very different Second World War lives in alternating short chapters, and their paths gradually move toward the walled port town of Saint-Malo.
readIf: you like lyrical, patient historical fiction told in very short chapters.
skipIf: you want a quick-paced war story; the structure and prose are deliberately slow.

pairings.reason: Another novel about young people and the small acts of decency they find in Nazi-era Europe.
A more plot-driven story of women's resistance in occupied France.
The same author's later, stranger novel linking stories across centuries around a lost book.
